diagrams.title: A rule of thumb for Future with Shivank Bank
diagrams.caption: A rule of thumb for Future with Shivank Bank: first ask "where may this data go?", then "how hard is the thinking?". Example: short intraday trade summaries → fast model; a multi-quarter financial analysis → reasoning model.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 720 340" aria-label="Two-by-two grid: data sensitivity on the vertical axis, reasoning depth on the horizontal axis. Public and simple tasks suit fast hosted models; public and complex suit hosted reasoning models; confidential tasks push you to self-hosted open models." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <rect class="zone" x="132" y="22" width="284" height="124" rx="10" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:none"></rect>
      <rect class="zone" x="424" y="22" width="284" height="124" rx="10" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:none"></rect>
      <rect class="zone" x="132" y="154" width="284" height="124" rx="10" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:none"></rect>
      <rect class="zone" x="424" y="154" width="284" height="124" rx="10" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:none"></rect>
      <text class="t15 b" x="148" y="56" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Small open model, self-hosted</text>
      <text class="t12" x="148" y="84" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">Data never leaves the bank's servers.</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" x="148" y="110" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">e.g. tag internal client emails by topic</text>
      <text class="t15 b" x="440" y="56" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Open reasoning model, self-hosted</text>
      <text class="t12" x="440" y="84" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">or an enterprise deal with data controls</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" x="440" y="110" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">e.g. credit review of private loan files</text>
      <text class="t15 b" x="148" y="188" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Fast hosted model (or FinBERT)</text>
      <text class="t12" x="148" y="216" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">Cheap, low latency, high volume.</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" x="148" y="242" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">e.g. score 50k public headlines an hour</text>
      <text class="t15 b" x="440" y="188" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Hosted reasoning model</text>
      <text class="t12" x="440" y="216" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">Slower, pricier, more careful.</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" x="440" y="242" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">e.g. compare 8 quarters of public filings</text>
      <text class="t12 b" x="122" y="88" text-anchor="end" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">Confidential</text>
      <text class="t12 b" x="122" y="220" text-anchor="end" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">Public</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" transform="translate(26 150) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">How sensitive is the data? →</text>
      <text class="t12 b" x="274" y="302" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">Simple, fast task</text>
      <text class="t12 b" x="566" y="302" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">Multi-step, deep reasoning</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" x="420" y="328" text-anchor="middle" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">How much reasoning does the task need? →</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: `response
diagrams.caption: `response.output[0].content[0].text` reads like opening a tiffin box: the box → its first compartment → the list inside → the first item → the text. **Shortcut:** `response.output_text` gives you the same text and is safer with reasoning models, where `output[0]` may be a reasoning item instead of the message.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 720 250" aria-label="Nested boxes: response contains an output list; item zero is the message; the message has a content list; content item zero holds the text, which is the JSON string." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <g class="nd"><rect x="10" y="10" width="700" height="230" rx="14" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect></g>
      <text class="mono t13 b" x="28" y="36" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">response</text><text class="t12 sub" x="110" y="36" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">— what responses.create(...) gives back</text>
      <g class="nd soft"><rect x="30" y="50" width="660" height="176" rx="12" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect></g>
      <text class="mono t13 b" x="46" y="74" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">.output</text><text class="t12 sub" x="112" y="74" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">— a list of items</text>
      <g class="nd"><rect x="50" y="86" width="430" height="128" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect></g>
      <text class="mono t13 b" x="66" y="108" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">[0]</text><text class="t12 sub" x="96" y="108" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">the message (the reply)</text>
      <g class="nd soft"><rect x="66" y="118" width="398" height="84" rx="9" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect></g>
      <text class="mono t12 b" x="80" y="138" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;font-weight:700">.content</text><text class="t12 sub" x="146" y="138" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">— a list of parts</text>
      <g class="nd hl"><rect x="80" y="148" width="370" height="42" rx="8" style="fill:#fff4d4;stroke:#835c00;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:2.4"></rect></g>
      <text class="mono t12" x="94" y="174" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">[0].text → '{"company": "Apple", "eps": 1.72, …}'</text>
      <rect x="496" y="86" width="178" height="128" rx="10" fill="none" class="dash" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.35;stroke-dasharray:5 5"></rect>
      <text class="mono t12 sub" x="512" y="108" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">[1], [2] …</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" x="512" y="130" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">other items, e.g.</text>
      <text class="t12 sub" x="512" y="148" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px;opacity:.68">reasoning or tool calls</text>
    </svg>
